title: A carrier next to an attack submarine, to one scale
caption: The Nimitz-class flight deck is nearly three times as long as a Virginia-class submarine.

sources.label: U.S. Navy fact file: Aircraft Carriers (CVN)
sources.says: Nimitz-class: length 1,092 feet (333 meters); flight deck width 252 feet (76.8 meters).
